answer:
Your Porto weekend note now has an app on its App side, and the check found no problems. It shows:
- **Countdown:** the days until Fri 16 Oct. You can change the start date in App Settings.
- **At a glance:** the flights, the hotel (with the confirmation number and check-in time) and the budget.
- **Ideas:** a list you can tick off.
- **To do before:** a second list you can tick off. Each list has a progress bar.

To make the ideas tickable, I changed the note's text. The ideas are now checkbox items under an "Ideas" heading, and "To do before" is now a heading. I also changed "budget ~ 6000 kr" to "budget: ~ 6000 kr" so it shows up in the at-a-glance section. Nothing else in the note changed.

  "guide": "# Building apps in Amber Notes notes

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner. In the tools it's called the note's page (set_note_page, get_note_page); when you talk to the person, call it "the note's app" or "the App side", and never "page" or "Pages".
